The page image is shown at about 1440 px wide, so I scaled its coordinates to the original 2479 px width using a factor of about 1.72.

The main advertisement, Sandoz Chemical Works, has a frame running from roughly x=201 to 1338 and y=225 to 1848 in the image. Scaled to the original page, that gives x0≈346, y0≈387, x1≈2303 and y1≈3181.

A sliver of another page's advertisement is visible at the right edge, starting around x=1395 in the image. It is cut off and unclear, so I left it out.
